verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's first-party stale-detection docs say it can automatically detect stale flags so teams can clean them up, which covers the stale-flag half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows code-reference scanning, so the 'find code references' half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: code references / repository scanning showing where flags are used, details on how stale detection works or what criteria it uses, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: GrowthBook can automatically detect these flags so you can clean them up.
